I'd at least consult a pro first, then decide whether to try to DIY, leave it to someone else, or just not fuck with it at all. If you call around you should be able to find someone willing to come to your house and give an analysis, advice, and price quote for reasonably cheap.

Looks to me like a container of something leaked there. Some stuff can stain granite at the surface. Try hydrogen peroxide on a small spot and scrub it with a washcloth to see if it removes any of it. It can buff out so long as the chemical structure of the stone hasn't been altered, but it can require some significant work, and would be better to practice before hand to get technique down and watch videos on it if it comes to it.

Does water still bead when water is dripped on it? If it does the seal is still good if not call a pro.
